title: NOTICE REGARDING SPECIALLY ASSIGNED CRIMINAL MATTERS UNTIL FURTHER ORDERS
text:
KEY LINES:
13.04.2026
09/04/2026

FULL TEXT:
NOTICE
This
is
to
inform
to
all
Learned
Advocates,
Litigants,
Stakeholders,
and
Parties-in-person
that
the Hon’ble
Chief Justice
has
been
pleased
to direct
that,
with
effect
from
13.04.2026
and
until
further
orders, specially
assigned
matters,
out
of
the
matters
listed
under
the heading/caption
“Fresh Matters”
in
the
cause
list
of
the
Hon’ble Court
(Coram:
Hon'ble
Mr.
Justice
Vimal
K.
Vyas)
will
be
listed
before the Hon’ble Court
(Coram:
Hon'ble
Mrs.
Justice
M.
K.
Thakker).
By
order
of
the Hon’ble the
Chief Justice
Date:
09/04/2026
Registrar
(Judicial)
